citations.assessment: The checked passage has Rav Yehudah bar Ishteta bringing fruit to Rav Natan bar Oshaya.
Rashi explicitly glosses Ishteta as a person’s name.
Alfasi’s digital text has Rav Yehudah Ish Bartota in the same fruit narrative.
The place-name pointer is explicit. It does not identify the Eruvin speaker with the tanna’s father.

holds.reason: The personal-name gloss is confirmed in Rashi. Arukh’s exact lexical notice remains open.
